name: typecheck
cmd: bun install --frozen-lockfile >/tmp/i.log 2>&1; timeout -s KILL 400 bun node_modules/typescript/lib/tsc.js -p . > /tmp/tc.log 2>&1; wc -l /tmp/tc.log; grep -v "vendor/" /tmp/tc.log | grep -vE "^research/(audit|enum)/" | head -40; echo; grep -oE "^[a-z]+/[a-z0-9-]+/?" /tmp/tc.log | sort | uniq -c
